request.query: norm of finite sum is at most sum of norms

items.name: norm_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_9} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖

items.name: norm_sum_le_of_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → E} {n : ι → ℝ},
  (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖ ≤ n b) → ‖∑ b ∈ s, f b‖ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b

items.name: nnnorm_sum_le_of_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → E} {n : ι → NNReal},
  (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖₊ ≤ n b) → ‖∑ b ∈ s, f b‖₊ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b

items.name: enorm_sum_le_of_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {ε : Type u_8} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε] (s : Finset ι)
  {f : ι → ε} {n : ι → ENNReal}, (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖ₑ ≤ n b) → ‖∑ b ∈ s, f b‖ₑ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b

items.name: nnnorm_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ a ∈ s, f a‖₊ ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, ‖f a‖₊

items.name: MeasureTheory.eLpNorm'_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ε' : Type u_4} {m : MeasurableSpace α} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε']
  [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε'] {q : ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [ContinuousAdd ε'] {ι : Type u_5}
  {f : ι → α → ε'} {s : Finset ι},
  (∀ i ∈ s, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (f i) μ) →
    1 ≤ q → MeasureTheory.eLpNorm' (∑ i ∈ s, f i) q μ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm' (f i) q μ

items.name: enorm_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {ε : Type u_9} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → ε), ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ₑ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ₑ

items.name: norm_multiset_sum_le
items.type: ∀ {E : Type u_9} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (m : Multiset E), ‖m.sum‖ ≤ (Multiset.map (fun x => ‖x‖) m).sum
